name: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Agility
summary: A transferable writ asks for one Elixir of Agility and gives details for delivery and payment. You need the writ to complete the exchange.

sections.title: A Written Request
sections.body: A faded note asks you to provide one Elixir of Agility. It also gives the delivery place and payment details. The writ can pass from one holder to another, but you need it with you to complete the exchange.

faq.q: What does the writ ask for?
faq.answer: The writ asks for one Elixir of Agility.
The writ gives a delivery location, marked on your map.
The writ includes information about payment.
Yes. The writ states that it can be transferred.

faq.q: Do I need the writ to complete the exchange?
faq.answer: Yes. You need to have the writ in your possession to complete the transaction.
